`OrderFacade.cancel` now throws an `IllegalStateException` for a CONFIRMED order and leaves its status unchanged.

The change is in `OrderService.cancel`: it loads the order, throws if the status is `CONFIRMED`, and otherwise sets it to `CANCELLED` as before. I followed the same exception style as `OrderReturns`. The test suite passes. I did not add a new test for the confirmed-order case.
